items.title: The Royal Navy & Gold Archway
items.subTitle: Swarna Dwar & Sacred Brass Bell
items.description: The breathtaking entrance arch finished in royal navy with intricate golden floral meenakari filigree, framing the suspended temple bell and marble sanctum.

items.title: The Ancient Sacred Mahavriksha
items.subTitle: Centuries-Old Banyan & Ashram Courtyard
items.description: The majestic sprawling ancient tree standing proudly over the ashram's interlocking terracotta tile courtyard, casting serene protective shade over all pilgrims.

items.title: The Marble Porch & Sacred Shrines
items.subTitle: Monsoon Serenity & Gnarled Roots
items.description: Looking outward from the polished white marble porch toward the ancient tree roots, orange Yajna Shala pavilion, and row of consecrated white samadhi shrines.

items.title: The Timeless Stone Archway
items.subTitle: Architectural Foundation & Bell
items.description: The foundational stone gateway structure, showing the enduring architectural pillars, suspended bell, and the serene view into the temple sanctum.
